from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.lighting import get_lighting_strategy_engine
import json

class Hou_Mcp_Lighting_Strategy(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_lighting_strategy"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("intent_text",  "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("environment",  "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("mood",         "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("lookdev_json", "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]
        self.add_output("strategy_json", "string")
        self.add_output("mood",          "string")
        self.add_output("environment",   "string")

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        intent_text  = str(inputs.get("intent_text",  "") or "")
        environment  = str(inputs.get("environment",  "") or "")
        mood         = str(inputs.get("mood",         "") or "")
        lookdev_json = str(inputs.get("lookdev_json", "") or "")
        try:
            lookdev_dict = json.loads(lookdev_json) if lookdev_json.strip() else {}
        except Exception:
            lookdev_dict = {}
        try:
            engine   = get_lighting_strategy_engine()
            strategy = engine.generate_strategy(
                intent_text=intent_text,
                environment=environment,
                mood=mood,
                lookdev_dict=lookdev_dict,
            )
            self.log_info(
                f"Lighting strategy: mood={strategy.mood}, env={strategy.environment}, "
                f"approach={strategy.approach}, volumetrics={strategy.volumetrics}."
            )
            return {
                "strategy_json": json.dumps(strategy.to_dict(), sort_keys=True, default=str),
                "mood":          strategy.mood,
                "environment":   strategy.environment,
                "exec_out": True,
            }
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"Lighting strategy failed: {exc}")
            return {"strategy_json": "{}", "mood": "", "environment": "", "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Lighting_Strategy
